items.title: Bed-Stuy Heatwave '89 Screen-Print
items.artistBio: Malik is a Bed-Stuy native and printmaker whose work channels 1980s Brooklyn street photography, vibrant signage, and cinematic warmth.
items.shortDescription: 4-color hand-pulled silkscreen capturing the sweltering heat, stoop conversations, and fiery pulse of Spike Lee's landmark 1989 film.
items.description: Printed by hand on French 100lb cover stock in radiant crimson, cadmium yellow, and asphalt black. Each print is hand-inspected, numbered in pencil, and stamped with the Atlas Archive seal. A vibrant homage to the block, the fire hydrants, and the radio sounds that defined an era of unapologetic Black storytelling.
specs: Ships rolled in heavy-duty kraft tube

items.title: Sanctuary Blues: Chicago Poetry Risograph
items.artistBio: Nia Thorne explores romanticism, spoken word culture, and urban intimacy across the Black Midwest through dual-drum risograph printmaking.
items.shortDescription: Two-drum risograph print honoring Theodore Witcher's 1997 masterpiece of Black bohemian love, jazz clubs, and rainy Chicago nights.
items.description: A love letter to Nina and Darius. Printed using soya-based soy inks in Federal Blue and Metallic Copper, creating a tactile stippled gradient that mirrors the glow of low-lit lounge stages and late-night vinyl sessions.

items.title: Indigo Waters: Gullah Geechee Giclée
items.artistBio: Zuri is a visual artist and cultural preservationist celebrating Sea Island traditions, ancestral memory, and Black feminine spirituality.
items.shortDescription: Museum-grade fine art print honoring Julie Dash's historic cinematic tapestry of the Peazant family on the eve of northern migration.
items.description: Richly rendered in ocean indigo, Spanish moss greens, and sun-bleached bone hues. Produced on Hahnemühle Photo Rag archival 308gsm cotton paper with pigment inks guaranteed colorfast for 100+ years. Captures the poetry of the unborn child and ancestral remembrance.

items.title: The Auteur Filmography Heavyweight Tee
items.artistBio: Atlas Studio creates tactile everyday garments honoring Black cinematic pioneers, cinematographers, and scriptwriters.
items.shortDescription: 10.5oz vintage-washed heavyweight tee paying tribute to Micheaux, Dash, Burnett, Parks, Singleton, and DuVernay.
items.description: Cut from ultra-heavy 100% combed cotton with a relaxed drop-shoulder silhouette and reinforced collar band. Features a discreet compass rose chest embroidery and archival filmography typography screenprinted on the back in soft-hand cream ink.
specs: Ethically knit and dyed in small batches

items.title: Love & Hate 16oz Cinema Tote
items.artistBio: Crafted in collaboration with Brooklyn textile artisans to carry books, records, 35mm film rolls, and everyday essentials.
items.shortDescription: Heavy-duty canvas tote celebrating cinematic resilience, with brass-knuckle typography and reinforced shoulder webbing.
items.description: Inspired by the unforgettable street philosophy of Radio Raheem. Constructed with double-stitched 16oz unbleached duck canvas, internal zippered valuables pocket, and key leash. Big enough for two 12" vinyl records or a weekend screenplay draft.
specs: 11" reinforced strap drop for comfortable shoulder carry

items.title: Cosmic Frequency: Afrofuturism Foil Print
items.artistBio: Kojo Mensah is a speculative visualist exploring Black liberation, cybernetics, and cosmic ancestry across African and Caribbean diaspora cinema.
items.shortDescription: Reflective gold and iridescent foil stamped art print celebrating Afrofuturist cinema, interstellar voyages, and Sun Ra's mythos.
items.description: Stamped with precision hot-foil onto matte obsidian French Plike cardstock. Under ambient light, the celestial constellations and hieroglyphic sound-waves shift between molten gold and electric violet. A beacon for seekers of outer-spatial freedom.

items.title: Soundtracks of Freedom: Curated 180g Vinyl
items.artistBio: Compiled in partnership with independent music archivists, restoring iconic cinematic soul, blaxploitation funk, and neo-soul film scores.
items.shortDescription: Special edition 180g amber-swirl vinyl compilation of essential themes and score cues that redefined the sound of cinema.
items.description: Mastered from original analog reels at half-speed for maximum dynamic range. Includes extensive liner notes by noted film scholars, behind-the-scenes recording session photographs, and a custom gatefold jacket printed on heavyweight raw chipboard.
specs: Heavy chipboard gatefold jacket with matte varnish
Includes download card for 24-bit/96kHz WAV files

items.title: Black Lens, Black Light: The Monograph
items.artistBio: A landmark scholarly and artistic survey celebrating Black directors of photography and lighting technicians who shaped visual culture.
items.shortDescription: 288-page clothbound monograph exploring lighting dark skin tones, composition, and visual sovereignty in Black cinema.
items.description: From Ernest Dickerson's saturated neon palettes to Bradford Young's meditative shadows and Arthur Jafa's rhythm of cut. Features over 180 high-fidelity production stills, technical lighting diagrams, and deep interviews with visionary image-makers.
specs: 288 pages on Munken Print White 150gsm paper
Embossed foil cover with tip-on image plate
Smyth-sewn binding designed to lay flat

items.title: Cinema Sanctuary Hand-Poured Soy Candle
items.artistBio: Handcrafted apothecary specializing in scents inspired by Southern gothic cinema, jazz corridors, and historic theatres.
items.shortDescription: 10oz amber glass candle with notes of Aged Velvet, Smoked Cedar, Warm Tobacco Leaf, and Golden Amber.
items.description: Formulated to recreate the atmosphere of entering a historic independent cinema on an autumn evening. Hand-poured using 100% domestic soy wax, phthalate-free fine fragrance oils, and a crackling FSC-certified cherry wood wick.
specs: 10 oz / 285g poured in heavy amber glass jar
Notes: Red velvet, Spanish cedar, vanilla pipe smoke, amber

items.title: The Golden Age 35mm Enamel Pin Set
items.artistBio: Commemorative jewelry and pins celebrating African American cultural milestones and indie cinema collectives.
items.shortDescription: Set of 3 antique brass and hard enamel pins: The Atlas Compass Rose, 35mm Film Canister, and Vintage Director Clapper.
items.description: Polished hard enamel with rich black cloisonné fill and antique brushed brass detailing. Fitted with dual deluxe rubber clutch backings to securely fasten to jackets, tote bags, or camera straps.
specs: Set of 3 collectible pins (1.25" to 1.5" each)
Hard enamel with antique gold metal finish
Dual posts with rubber locking clutches
Mounted on custom letterpress collector card
Stamped with Atlas Archive hallmark on reverse

items.title: The Black Coming-of-Age Canon: Digital Syllabus
items.artistBio: Curated by the Atlas editorial collective and guest film educators, tracing youth, intimacy, and summer warmth across Black cinema.
items.shortDescription: Comprehensive 120-page interactive syllabus & Notion hub covering 50 landmark coming-of-age films, shot breakdowns, and essays.
items.description: An essential syllabus for students, cinephiles, and lovers of Black storytelling. Explores four distinct movements: 'Late 90s Bohemian Romance', 'Southern Roots & Ancestral Memory', 'Afrofuturist Adolescence', and 'Gen Z Digital Intimacy'. Includes high-res printable film trackers, director interview transcripts, and streaming deep-links.
specs: Instant delivery via email & account dashboard
50 in-depth film breakdowns with thematic lineage maps
Free lifetime updates as new films join the canon

items.title: L.A. Rebellion 'Film School in a Box' Field Guide
items.artistBio: Marcus Vance is a film historian and 16mm archivist documenting the UCLA radical cinema movement of the 1970s and 1980s.
items.shortDescription: Field guide examining guerilla filmmaking, low-light cinematography, non-actors, and independent distribution.
items.description: Drawing from the revolutionary filmmaking practices of Charles Burnett, Haile Gerima, Julie Dash, and Larry Clark. Provides shot-by-shot analyses of landmark sequences, archival production notes, lighting breakdowns for darker skin tones with natural tungsten, and historical context.
specs: 160-page softcover journal printed on uncoated recycled paper
Includes companion digital PDF and storyboard asset pack
Rare archival production stills and original director notes
Includes embossed bookmark styled as a 16mm film leader
